title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Section 39 (manuscript p. 299; folio 21 of the file), titled 'Les conditions de congruence pour l'opération extérieure de Γ_Q sur π̂_{0,3}'. This belongs to the 1981 Longue Marche material.

The setting:
- N_{1,1} is the arithmetic fundamental group of the moduli stack M_{1,1} over Q.
- Ĉ^+_{1,1} is its geometric part. It is the profinite completion of the oriented mapping class group of the once-punctured torus, i.e. of SL(2,Z).
- This gives the exact sequence 1 → SL(2,Z)^ → N_{1,1} → Γ_Q → 1.

The Tate module of the universal elliptic curve is Ẑ², the profinite abelianization of π_1 of the punctured torus. It gives a representation ρ: N_{1,1} → GL(2,Ẑ). On the geometric part ρ restricts to the canonical map SL(2,Z)^ → SL(2,Ẑ). Its kernel is the congruence kernel; the map is surjective but very far from injective.

Compatibility on the quotient (det ∘ ρ = χ, the cyclotomic character) is the Weil pairing. It yields a morphism of extensions, diagram (1).

Consequences:
- The outer action Γ_Q → Out(SL(2,Z)^) descends to an outer action on the congruence quotient SL(2,Ẑ).
- That descended action factors as χ followed by the map (3), Ẑ* → Out(SL(2,Ẑ)). Map (3) comes from the extension 1→SL(2,Ẑ)→GL(2,Ẑ)→Ẑ*→1: lift λ to diag(1,λ) and conjugate.

On the next page Grothendieck proves that (3) factors through Ẑ*/Ẑ*² and is injective there. Scalars λ act trivially and have determinant λ². Conversely, if int(u) is inner then u·u_0^{-1} centralizes SL(2,Ẑ), so it is scalar, so det u is a square.

Purpose: SL(2,Z) contains Γ(2), and Γ(2)/±1 ≅ π_1(P¹−{0,1,∞}). So this computes the 'congruence part' of the Galois action on π̂_{0,3}. It is the image of the action after passing to the congruence completion, which is entirely cyclotomic. The non-congruence part is what carries genuinely new arithmetic. It is the first step in isolating that 'non-cyclotomic' part, or in using congruence conditions to constrain the action. The previous page sets up the explicit uniformisation D/GL(1,Z)^+ ≅ P¹ minus points and the elements τ'_0, τ'_1, τ'_∞ needed to make this concrete.
errors: No genuine error. Commutativity of the right-hand square (det ∘ ρ = χ, or χ^{-1} depending on convention) is asserted without comment; it is the Weil pairing.
The identification Ĉ^+_{1,1} ≅ SL(2,Z)^ is correct for the stack M_{1,1} (with the generic ±1). If one instead uses PSL(2,Z), a central ±1 must be tracked; it is harmless for outer actions.

ideas.what: Exact sequence of the arithmetic fundamental group of M_{1,1} over Q, mapped to GL(2,Ẑ) via the Tate module, with det = cyclotomic character
ideas.modern_name: Monodromy / adelic Galois representation of the universal elliptic curve; arithmetic π_1 of M_{1,1}
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Weil pairing, Shimura, Deligne–Rapoport); in anabelian form Ihara, Nakamura, Matsumoto
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses Γ_Q acting on the Teichmüller tower including M_{1,1}, but not this diagram explicitly

ideas.what: Outer Galois action on SL(2,Z)^ descends to the congruence quotient SL(2,Ẑ) and is given there by the cyclotomic character
ideas.modern_name: Galois action on the congruence completion / fields of definition of the modular curves X(N)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Shimura; Deligne–Rapoport); anabelian framing by Ihara and Nakamura

ideas.what: Ẑ* → Out(SL(2,Ẑ)) factors through Ẑ*/Ẑ*² and is injective there. So the congruence outer action of Γ_Q factors exactly through Gal(Q(√Q*)/Q), the compositum of all quadratic fields
ideas.modern_name: Out(SL_2) contribution from PGL_2 / GL_2 conjugation modulo squares

missed.claim: The programme stated in the title is only begun here. It asks for the 'congruence conditions' on the outer Galois action on π̂_{0,3} (equivalently on Γ(2)^), splitting the action into a cyclotomic/congruence part and a remaining non-congruence part. That remaining part lives on the congruence kernel ker(SL(2,Z)^ → SL(2,Ẑ)). This is closely related to later work (Ihara, Nakamura, Matsumoto, Boggi) on Galois actions and the congruence kernel; it is not clearly new.
missed.quote: Les conditions de congruence pour l'opération extérieure de Γ_Q sur π̂_{0,3}
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It is an early explicit framing of the Galois action on the congruence kernel as the 'non-cyclotomic' content of the action on π̂_{0,3}. It is of historical interest rather than a new result.

deep.surprise_reason: The mathematics is correct and standard: descent of the outer action to SL(2,Ẑ) via χ, and the factorization through Ẑ*/Ẑ*². Its interest is the 1981 framing linking the congruence quotient to the Galois action on π̂_{0,3}. Later anabelian literature developed this, so little would surprise a specialist.
transcription_corrections: Page number 299 at top is part of the manuscript numbering; 21 at bottom left is the archive folio.
The crossed-out word before 'Les conditions' is illegible; 'Remarques[?]' is uncertain.
